en.topic_title: China condemns US designation of Confucius Institutes as threat

zh.topic_title: China condemns US designation of Confucius Institutes as threat

en.topic_title: China condemns US designation of Confucius Institutes as threat
en.topic_summary:
China accused the United States on Monday of “targeted smearing” over Washington’s designation of Beijing-funded Confucius Institute cultural centres as national security threats.



The Confucius Institute at Seneca Polytechnic. Photo: Wikicommons.



Washington considers the centres on American university campuses as propaganda tools of the Chinese Communist Party and has imposed funding restrictions on the institutes since 2025.



US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on F
